query:
UPDATE organization_env_vars
            SET encrypted_value = $3, updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2
            RETURNING
                id              AS "id!: Uuid",
                organization_id AS "organization_id!: Uuid",
                name            AS "name!",
                created_at      AS "created_at!",
                updated_at      AS "updated_at!"
